item.description:
1.1.33 — Just the site

  • Nothing above the page. Sites run right to the top, with the glass controls floating over them, whether the sidebar is open or closed. The coloured bar is gone.
  • Address in the sidebar, if you like. Settings › Appearance › Address and controls puts back, forward, reload and the address at the top of the sidebar instead.
  • A real slide. The sidebar and your tabs slide out to the left together as the page grows, with no fading.
  • Frosted messages. The little messages at the bottom of the page are frosted Liquid Glass.
  • A simpler sidebar. The space's name is gone from above your tabs. To rename a space or change its icon and color, use the pencil next to it in the bottom-left menu.
  • The new logo everywhere. What's New, Settings and your member card all show it now.

1.1.32 — Smooth sidebar

  • Hiding the sidebar is one motion. The sidebar slides away as the page widens to fill its place, and the top bar glides down in step. Showing it again reverses the same way.

1.1.31 — Press to peek

  • Force click a link to see it in a preview that grows out of where you pressed. Shift-click still works too.
  • Site settings. The slider button in the address opens a glass panel for the site you're on: whether it's secure, switches for sound, ad blocking, pop-out video and separate logins, its zoom, and its cookies.
  • A tidier sidebar. The space's name sits under the address, your initials sit at the bottom, and hovering a tab is instant.
  • A new welcome. Meet Pane fills the window, follows light and dark, brings your tabs over from Arc, Chrome, Dia, Helium and more, and shows how a new tab really works.
  • A new icon.
